text:
Which is the best description of the speed of a water wave?
A
the distance between one wave crest and the next
B
the distance between the crest of a wave and a trough
C
the distance that a particle of water moves up and down in one second
D
the distance that a wavefront moves along the surface in one second

options.label: A
options.text: the distance between one wave crest and the next

options.label: B
options.text: the distance between the crest of a wave and a trough

options.label: C
options.text: the distance that a particle of water moves up and down in one second

options.label: D
options.text: the distance that a wavefront moves along the surface in one second
